verdict.comment: The vote goes to FURTHER MEASURE who is taken to enhance his good record over C&D (113).

comments.capone: Just 1-26 on the Flat; can go well fresh but others still make greater appeal today
comments.captainrobert: Bit disappointing last time, but in good form before that; blinkers on
comments.finalentry: Only had six starts; half-brother to a three-time winner over 1m6f/2m on the AW
comments.furthermeasure: Has a good record here (4711134) including two wins over this trip; respected
comments.grandduchessolga: Capable on her day, but not the most consistent and has run poorly in both starts over C&D
comments.kingscruiser: Improved when fourth on handicap debut at Wolverhampton last time, but still more needed
comments.princequattro: Record in handicaps at this track reads 221; much respected back here
comments.skycutter: Up 3lb after making all over 1m6f here last time; still unexposed in AW staying handicaps
comments.trojansoldier: 0-8 but runner-up in three of his last four starts; probably needs a bit more
